definitions.explanation: A device with colored lights used to control traffic at intersections.
A gesture, action, or sound that conveys information or instructions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{信号|しんごう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{右|みぎ}→右：02257_migi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{曲|ま}がって→曲がる：00649_magaru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please turn right at the next traffic light.

examples.japanese: {信号|しんごう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{青|あお}→青：02841_ao⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なったら→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{渡|わた}って→渡る：02441_wataru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please cross when the light turns green.
examples.notes: In Japanese, the green light is called ⟦{青|あお}→青：02841_ao⟧ (blue)

examples.japanese: {信号|しんごう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧。
⟦{電波|でんぱ}→電波：04070_denpa⟧{信号|しんごう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受信|じゅしん}→受信：04896_jushin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。

⟦{出発|しゅっぱつ}→出発：02085_shuppatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{信号|しんごう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}たら→出る：00513_deru⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{走|はし}り→走る：00519_hashiru⟧⟦{始|はじ}めて→～始める：18370_hajimeru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: When the starting signal is given, please begin running immediately.

notes:
{信号|しんごう} most commonly refers to traffic lights in everyday conversation.

TRAFFIC LIGHT COLORS:
- ⟦{青|あお}→青：02841_ao⟧{信号|しんごう} (green light - literally "blue signal")
- ⟦{赤|あか}→赤：02842_aka⟧{信号|しんごう} (red light)
- ⟦{黄色|きいろ}→黄色：02870_kiiro⟧{信号|しんごう} (yellow light)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {信号|しんごう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{無視|むし}→無視：13473_mushi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to ignore a traffic light)
- {信号|しんごう}⟦{待|ま}ち→待つ：00469_matsu⟧ (waiting at a traffic light)
- ⟦{信号|しんごう}{機|き}→信号機：27201_shingouki⟧ (traffic light device)
- {信号|しんごう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧ (to send a signal)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, the green light is traditionally called ⟦{青|あお}→青：02841_ao⟧ (blue) rather than ⟦{緑|みどり}→緑：00970_midori⟧ (green).
